# Pull Request

## Summary

Describe the change and the engineering or learning problem it addresses.

## Change Type

- [ ] React or TypeScript feature
- [ ] API integration
- [ ] AI workflow
- [ ] Runtime validation
- [ ] Test, lint, or build tooling
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Security improvement
- [ ] Dependency or version update

## Validation

- [ ] Formatting check passes.
- [ ] Type checking passes.
- [ ] Lint passes.
- [ ] Relevant tests pass.
- [ ] Production build passes.
- [ ] External data is validated at runtime where relevant.
- [ ] No secrets, personal data, or confidential prompts are included.
- [ ] Frontend code does not expose privileged API keys.
- [ ] Dependency and lockfile changes were reviewed.
- [ ] Error, loading, empty, and failure states were considered.
- [ ] Accessibility impact was reviewed for UI changes.
- [ ] Documentation, version matrix, and changelog were updated when required.
- [ ] The contribution is compatible with the MIT License.

## Test Evidence

List commands run and summarize the results.

## Security, Privacy, and AI Impact

Describe trust boundaries, data handling, model/provider assumptions, retention, cost, or other relevant risks.
